question: Article 246A empowers both Parliament and State Legislatures to make laws related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taxation of goods and services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This article was introduced through the **101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016**, which was a landmark reform to unify indirect taxation in India.
 
• **Property rights:** This does not come under Article 246A but is covered under other provisions such as **Article 300A**, which deals with protection of property rights. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
 
• **Emergency provisions:** These are governed under **Part XVIII** of the Constitution, covering Articles **352 to 360**. Emergency provisions are unrelated to Article 246A. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
 
• **Criminal law:** Criminal laws fall under the concurrent list and are primarily governed by various acts such as the **Indian Penal Code (IPC)** and the **Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC).** They are unrelated to Article 246A. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST):**

 
 
• It is categorized into **CGST** (Central Goods and Services Tax), **SGST** (State Goods and Services Tax), and **IGST** (Integrated Goods and Services Tax) depending on the type of transaction.
 
• This amendment introduced **Article 246A**, empowering both Parliament and State Legislatures to legislate on GST matters.
 
• GST implementation reflects cooperative federalism, as both Central and State governments share taxation powers.
 
• The **GST Council**, chaired by the Union Finance Minister, includes representatives from all states and UTs. It was constituted under **Article 279A**.
 
• GST has eliminated the cascading effect of taxes, reduced complexities in the taxation system, and improved transparency in tax collection.
 
• 
• It has enhanced revenue generation and enabled ease of doing business across India.
